features.name: Spellcasting
features.description:
When you reach 3rd level, you gain druidic spellcasting. WIS is your spellcasting ability.

**Spell save DC** = 8 + prof + WIS modifier.
**Spell attack modifier** = prof + WIS modifier.

You learn *shillelagh* plus two other druid cantrips (another at 10th level). You know 3 1st-level druid spells (2 must be divination or transmutation). See the Underfoot Spellcasting table for spell slots and spells known (up to 4th-level slots at Rogue 19).

features.name: Versatile Shillelagh
features.description: Beginning at 3rd level, when you cast *shillelagh*, it lasts 1 hour and ends early only if another creature holds the weapon or it's more than 5 feet away from you for 1 minute. Your Sneak Attack feature can be applied to attack rolls made with your *shillelagh* weapon.

features.name: Undermine
features.description: Beginning at 9th level, as an action, dig a hole under a Large or smaller creature within 5 ft. DEX save (DC 8 + prof + DEX mod) or it falls prone. On failure, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action against it.

payload.name: Undermine
payload.description: Dig hole under Large or smaller creature within 5 ft: DEX save or prone. On failure: bonus action weapon attack against it.

features.name: Death From Below
features.description: Beginning at 13th level, when you move at least 10 feet underground toward a target, your next attack against it with your *shillelagh* weapon has advantage.

features.name: Vicious
features.description: At 17th level, when you use your Death From Below feature and hit the target with your *shillelagh* weapon, the target is restrained by vegetation and soil until the end of its next turn.
